panels.title: Active memberships
panels.description: Paid up with time left today. Matches the headline figure on the portal's Insights page.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Active"
FROM subscriptions
WHERE "cancelledAt" IS NULL
  AND "startDate" <= CURRENT_DATE
  AND "endDate" >= CURRENT_DATE;

panels.title: Expiring in 7 days
panels.description: The renewal call list. Anything here is a conversation the desk should be having this week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Expiring"
FROM subscriptions
WHERE "cancelledAt" IS NULL
  AND "endDate" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7;

panels.title: Collected this month
panels.description: Sum of amountPaid on memberships sold since the 1st. Cash taken at the desk — there is no payment gateway.

panels.title: Outstanding
panels.description: Sold but not fully paid, on memberships that have not been cancelled. Instalments the desk is still owed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum("price" - "discount" - "amountPaid"), 0) AS "Owing"
FROM subscriptions
WHERE "cancelledAt" IS NULL
  AND ("price" - "discount" - "amountPaid") > 0;

panels.title: Check-ins per day
panels.description: Arrivals, split by how the visit was recorded. There is no check-out, so this is a register rather than occupancy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "localDate"::timestamptz AS time,
  source AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM check_ins
WHERE $__timeFilter("localDate"::timestamptz)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Plan mix
panels.description: What members actually buy, all time. planName is copied onto each sale, so renaming a plan does not rewrite history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "planName" AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM subscriptions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: New memberships sold per week
panels.description: Sales, not renewals-adjusted revenue. A renewal counts as a sale here because it is one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('week', "createdAt") AS time,
  count(*) AS "Sold"
FROM subscriptions
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
